slides.heading: Use Case 1: Preview Vocabulary
slides.content:
Teacher selects 5–10 glossary words before starting a unit.
• Students listen to the words
• Discuss meanings
• Predict the topic.
Goal: Activate background knowledge and create interest.
slides.notes: Introduce practical ways teachers can use the Q Skills glossary.

slides.heading: Use Case 2: Vocabulary Building
slides.content:
Teacher selects a glossary noun.
• Students identify common verbs used with the noun.
• Examples:
 hobby → have, pursue, enjoy, develop, take up
information → collect, gather, share, provide

slides.heading: Use Case 3: Vocabulary Building
slides.content:
Teacher selects a glossary verb.
• Students identify common nouns that occur with the verb.
• Examples:
collect → information, data, money, stamps, coins
make → decision, plan, mistake, effort, appointment

slides.heading: Use Case 4: Context Clue Training
slides.content:
Teacher creates sentences containing glossary words.
• Students use context clues to guess meanings before checking definitions.
Goal: Develop independent vocabulary-learning skills.
slides.notes: Can be used before introducing dictionary definitions.

slides.heading: Use Case 5: Student Example Sentences
slides.content:
Students create original sentences using glossary words.
• Teacher provides feedback on meaning, grammar, and collocations.
Goal: Move vocabulary from recognition to active use

slides.heading: Use Case 7: Use AI- Show Screenshots
slides.content:
Students use AI tools to explore glossary words.
Example tasks:
• Find common collocations.
• Generate example sentences.
• Compare word meanings.
Goal: Promote learner autonomy.

slides.heading: Use Case 8: Vocabulary Review Games
slides.content:
Teacher uses glossary words in quizzes, matching activities, and speaking games.
• Students review words from previous units.
Goal: Improve long-term retention.

slides.heading: Use Case 9: Presentation Preparation
slides.content:
Students select glossary words related to a presentation topic.
• They prepare definitions, collocations, and example sentences.
Goal: Strengthen academic speaking skills.

slides.heading: Use Case 10: Reflection and Self-Assessment
slides.content:
Students review glossary words and identify:
• Words they know
• Degrees of nowledge
• Words they still need to learn
Goal: Develop self-monitoring skills.
